Visitor.title: Visitor
Visitor.description: Information about a library visitor registered at the kiosk

id.description: Unique identifier of the visitor record

visit_number.description: A serialized daily unique visit sequence number

institution.description: The agency, school, or organization the visitor represents

position.description: Job position or status of the visitor

phone.description: Active phone number of the visitor

email.description: Valid email address of the visitor

country_code.description: ISO Country code of visitor origin

visitor_count.description: Number of companions or people in the visit group

visit_category.description: Type/Category of visit (e.g. Umum, Siswa, Guru)

impression.description: Impression about library facilities or services

suggestion.description: Feedback, suggestions, or critique for improvement

signature_file.description: Base64 encoded string representing the visitor's signature

visitor_photo.description: Base64 encoded string representing the captured camera photo

language.description: Preferred language of interface used during registration

visit_date.description: The date the visit occurs formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

created_at.description: Timestamp when the record was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated

SystemSettings.title: SystemSettings
SystemSettings.description: Global application properties and synthesizer controls

id.description: Constant ID of the settings record

tts_enabled.description: Whether Text-to-Speech audio synthesizer welcoming is active

tts_volume.description: The pitch/volume of greeting speech (index from 0 to 1)

tts_rate.description: The pacing of greeting speech (index from 0.5 to 2.0)

library_name.description: Customized header name of the library

library_logo.description: Base64 string representing custom header logo image

/visitors/{visitorId}.description: Registry of guests who registered at the library desk

/system_settings/{settingsId}.description: Persistent global settings for headers and speech synthesis rates
